description: This script is a test suite for the 'git rm' command with the '--pathspec-from-file' option. It sets up a temporary git repository, performs various removal operations based on file lists provided via standard input or files, and verifies the expected outcomes, including error conditions.

methods.name: restore_checkpoint
methods.description: Resets the git repository to the checkpoint tag to restore the initial state.

methods.name: verify_expect
methods.description: Verifies the current git status against the expected output.

calls: git status --porcelain --untracked-files=no -- fileA.t fileB.t fileC.t fileD.t
git add fileA.t fileB.t fileC.t fileD.t
git status --porcelain --untracked-files=no -- fileA.t fileB.t fileC.t fileD.t
